title: QorCap bundle.json (fields QorTime reads; extra fields allowed)

challenge_rule.description: Official challenge measurement. Absent or 1: segment_ranges clock and pause 0..600 ms. 2: fragment PTS clock, pause 0..2500 ms, latencies within ±300 ms of their median, default 16/8 dark-menu caps. 3: same clock, ceiling, and spread as 2, with capture-path dark-menu caps 26/16. A rule-2 bundle from QorCap >= 0.3.31 is measured as 3.
